identity.title: Protected Authentication, Signing & Execution Gateway
identity.objective: Implement after independent certification and explicit Gate A authorization the smallest production-quality protected Polymarket authentication, signing, LIMIT-order construction, Gate-B-locked mutation, authoritative reconciliation, heartbeat, recovery, audit, and read-only cockpit gateway while preserving WP173 invariants and excluding all real-secret, real-mutation, and live-capital authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP174. The protected gateway source, SQLite audit/recovery state, backend-only cockpit projection, exact SDK/websockets pins, CI assertion, focused tests, and status/governance evidence are removed. WP173 paper evidence remains unchanged. No real credential, real venue mutation, live capital, Hermes authority, frontend redesign, strategy, scheduler, or deployment state is created or migrated.
